pipelines.name: Check Licenses

with.rules:
# Explicitly allow LGPL as "*GPL*" rule will cause to reject them otherwise.
- pattern: "*lgpl*"
  name: "allow-lgpl"
  mode: "allow"
  reason: "LGPL is allowed."
- pattern: "*gpl*"
  name: "deny-gpl"
  mode: "deny"
  reason: "GPL licenses are not compatible with BSD-3-Clause"
- pattern: "*proprietary*"
  name: "deny-proprietary"
  mode: "deny"

findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'default' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
